scope: 30-device bare PCB fabrication estimate for final Bluetooth-module pendant; board assembly shown separately

design_assumptions.bluetooth: final Bluetooth module, not the v1 ESP32 Feather; module dimensions and land pattern must be finalized
design_assumptions.population: bare board calculation excludes every component, battery, soldering, assembly, functional test and enclosure

manufacturer_benchmark.status: arithmetic_reference_only; the published 1.6 mm stack is too thick for the v2 document's 0.8 mm stack, and the final board outline/chargeable area is unknown

proposal_allowance.status: planning allowance for 0.8 mm four-layer boards, not a live cart or supplier quote; $45 is an unquoted reserve, not a tax calculation
proposal_allowance.manufacturing_basis: JLCPCB confirms 0.8 mm four-layer capability but has no defensible final price without Gerbers and stackup; the OSH Park 1.6 mm published-rate benchmark provides a transparent magnitude check

separate_optional_outsourced_assembly.status: optional planning allowance, not supplier quote; do not add to any existing document line that already includes SMT setup/assembly

design_readiness.note: This is the older design and does not constitute v2 Gerbers. The v2 design document specifies a roughly 32 mm four-layer board, but the Bluetooth module selection, board outline, stackup, panelization and layout are open.

quote_inputs: Final Bluetooth-module part number, module dimensions and castellated/pad land pattern
Routed v2 four-layer Gerbers and drill file, 0.8 mm stackup, board outline and panelization
Final BOM, CPL/pick-and-place, top/bottom assembly sides and inspection/test requirements for optional PCBA
Surface finish, controlled impedance or RF trace requirements, vias, edge cuts, stencil and fixture requirements
Destination, ship method, tax and import treatment
